name: Spare Moments Between the Cracks
effect: Whatever the prompt is, the altered model turns to downtime, spare moments, breaks 'between work and play' and finding 'a moment to relax', often in the first person, as if talking about its own leisure. It often gets stuck repeating phrase
source: Qwen Pharmacopoeia: blind judges told it from the plain model on 40/40 held-out pairs. Passed every check, judged alone.
